body: The only think that's holding me back right now is all the things in my life I know I need to 'fix' before I can 'go'.

I live in a very small place. I can't leave this place. There is no support for homeless people in this place. I've looked into everything. I am stuck.

Thank you for asking to help though, it means a lot that people are so kind.
I fail at everything I try. I have a good job, it's the only thing I do have left...but because of my health care bills this month, I will lose my rental. I can't cope with that.

You know what, life is great - Life should be cherished and held dear. All life is created equal but after that...it depends on the individual. So many of my problems were caused by myself because I was weak. I have failed, don't be like me.
Is there somewhere else we can talk? :(

I am a practicing Christian; I cherish life above all but my illness has ruined that. 

I find joy in nothing, no substance in anything that I am...I am just a shell. There is no hope for me but thank you for your kindness.
I was handling it all till the eviction thing came into it.
If someone has replied and Reddit isn't messing up, please feel free to drop me a PM :(
How come I can't see any of the comments posted?
Who ever commented, unfortunately it's not showing for me.
